name: qlrisk_price_fx_option
title: Price a FXOption
description:
Price one FX Vanilla Option (qlrisk FXOption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, option_type=call (call/put), digital=false, payout, strike, pair, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, domestic_curve, foreign_curve, foreign_rate_pct, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 38,930.25 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
